levels.surface: أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف

notes: «أنه سمع حسان بن ثابت الأنصاري» is the «سمع» link (rule 5). Hassan adjures Abu Hurayra («يستشهد أبا هريرة»): the asker and the asked are both links, and Abu Hurayra answers «نعم», so his words relay the saying (rule 5, rule 6).
The Prophet's words to Hassan are the saying; the Prophet is not a link.
